summary: Requested an execution that puts the membership eligibility matrix under observation. A fixed thirteen-case sequence runs against one ordered membership object: adding a node, re-adding it, adding an observer, promoting that observer with the same address, adding an observer at a duplicate address, adding a witness, re-adding the witness as observer and as node, removing and re-adding a removed node, removing the observer and witness, and removing the only remaining member. Each case emits a CA_EVENT with its acceptance outcome for comparison against the acceptance predicates and the request-path documentation. Registered the investigation and cited the membership sources; no conclusion before the receipt.
